protection.access_closed: Tokenlogue is locked. Enter your PIN.
protection.unavailable: Your conversations could not be opened. Try signing in again. Your data is kept.
protection.key_missing: Your conversation key is missing or damaged. Your data is kept, but a new PIN or API key cannot restore it.
protection.initialization_unavailable: Chat protection could not finish. Try signing in again. If the error continues, keep your app data and ask for help.
service.database_in_use: Another Tokenlogue window is using this profile. Close other copies and try again.
protection.binding_mismatch: Sign-in could not open this profile. Use an available recovery method. Your data is kept.
protection.native_reason: Authenticate with your device to choose a new Tokenlogue PIN.
protection.recovery_unavailable: Device recovery is unavailable. Check your device screen lock. Your app PIN and conversations are kept.
protection.recovery_cancelled: Device authentication was not completed. Your existing PIN and chats have been preserved.
protection.sign_in_first: Sign in before replacing the OpenRouter key. If you forgot your PIN, choose recovery. A new API key cannot unlock old conversations.
protection.replace_key: Enter your new OpenRouter key. Your app PIN and chats will be kept.
